verdict.rationale: Windmill documents webhooks extensively as a trigger mechanism—scripts and flows can be invoked via webhook endpoints, including version-pinned endpoints for specific flow versions—which lets external systems call into Windmill (windmill-docs-15, windmill-docs-16). However, this is primarily inbound triggering rather than an outbound event-subscription model where Windmill pushes notifications about internal events (e.g., job completion, failures) to a subscriber's webhook URL. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of outbound webhook subscriptions/event notifications, independent confirmation of an event-driven push webhook system, and any first-party mention of 'subscribe' semantics rather than pure trigger endpoints.
